request_turn_1.assistant_capability: server issues tool_calls; client executes locally

id_grammar_observed.class: server-issued opaque string; client replays verbatim

read_tool.argument_note: OpenCode read takes filePath (relative workspace path accepted); NOT the Hermes path key

native_output_wrap.envelope_structure: 3 header lines, 1 line-number-prefixed content line per file line, 1 empty line, 2 footer lines
native_output_wrap.note: do not equate tool message content with raw file bytes; verify by marker presence/correlation

verification_gate.correlation: tool message tool_call_id equals the server-issued call id
verification_gate.exact_result_roundtrip: final client text equals the unpredictable marker extracted from the correlated native tool result
